_comment: Thresholds for check_quality.py and check_contract.py. Tune per project; do not delete keys.
_swallow_comment: Flags an except/catch block that drops the exception without a comment saying why. Set false to switch the check off.
_scope_comment: Project scope: skript, werkzeug or produkt. Scales documentation duty and elicitation depth only - never requirements, never rigid guardrails. See .claude/rules/workflow.md.
_gate_comment: Paths the start gate never blocks: tooling, tests and examples are not the product. Everything that is not a source file is exempt anyway.
